title: Shulker accounts
description: The accounts shulker signed in or created itself, and their tokens. Borrowed accounts are read from another launcher's own file and never written here.

$schema.description: The version of this file, as a published schema URL.

accounts.description: Every account shulker holds, own and offline alike.

account.description: An account needs something to name it by and something to identify it: a Java profile, or the Xbox side of an account that owns no profile. An offline account always has a profile, because shulker made it.

type.description: microsoft is an account signed in through Microsoft; offline is one created with `shulker accounts add`.

profile.description: The Java profile. Its presence is the proof the account owns Java Edition; a Microsoft account without one is named by its gamertag and can't launch.

xbox.description: The Xbox Live side of a Microsoft account: what names it when it owns no Java profile, and the user token while it lasts.

refreshToken.description: The Microsoft refresh token, rotated on every use. Without it the account is `sign-in expired`.

minecraft.description: The Minecraft session token a launch reuses until it is within an hour of expiring.

id.description: The player UUID, as `/minecraft/profile` gives it.

xuid.description: The 16-digit Xbox user id, which identifies an account that owns no Java profile.

gamertag.description: The Xbox gamertag, which names an account that owns no Java profile. It may contain spaces and is not unique.

userHash.description: The user hash the Minecraft login header carries beside the XSTS token.

token.description: The XSTS token, kept only while notAfter holds.

notAfter.description: When the XSTS token stops being usable.

expiresAt.description: When the session token stops being usable.
